method: Offline bounded Hexagon disassembly of extracted DSP2; runtime control test separately recorded
nvram_layout: variables placed below RAM-end token; complement/word-count token at RAM end minus four
upload_ram_direction: r1=0 reads device RAM into host buffer; not a firmware RAM overwrite
findings: File-transfer loop uses actual positive read count and advances by it until EOF
No fixed image-length check or CRC validation observed in examined transfer loop; this is not proof of absence elsewhere
dhd_upload_ram reads RAM, including any appended probe; it does not erase it
New probe changes main call after hardware/stack setup and preserves numeric version syntax
limitations: Hexagon packet semantics must be respected; raw disassembly is not an execution trace
Hardware ROM startup, memory mapping and firmware acceptance still require live evidence
Neither failed probe nor a future marker by itself proves packet forwarding or WireGuard
